snippet.title: It Took 47 Attempts to Make Our Sofa Fly | Will It Launch?
snippet.description:
We bolted fridge doors to a sofa and kept crashing until attempt 47 finally flew. Then our friends joined in. What could go wrong?

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5205090/Will_It_Launch/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=wishlist_trailers_20261005&utm_content=h1_attempt47

Will It Launch? is an online co-op physics comedy for 1-4 players with proximity voice chat. Turn a bathtub, a sofa or a toilet cabin into a plane and fly cargo between three islands. Your friends help you build it. They also have angle grinders, the shared wallet and, eventually, a bomb.

All footage is real gameplay.
